packageRules.description: SHA-pin every GitHub Actions reference — matches this repo's own workflow-security invariant.
Group routine npm minor/patch bumps into one PR. astro and @astrojs/* are excluded here and handled by the rule below.

astro and @astrojs/* (root package.json) move together in one PR. astro is pinned to a minor range (~7.3) and the integrations are exact pins; rangeStrategy replace keeps each range as written, so a patch stays inside it and a minor (~7.4) is a deliberate bump. Each such PR needs the acceptance build green before merge.
prBodyNotes: Needs the acceptance build before merge: `npm test` (includes test/acceptance) and `task quality:web`.

packageRules.description: docs/ (Starlight site): astro and @astrojs/starlight are bounded by the ocx theme's peer ranges (starlight >=0.42 <0.43, astro ^7), so they move as one dedicated PR, merged only together with the matching @ocx-sh/theme release.
